scope: New local demonstration batches; existing frozen releases retain their original acceptance records

requirements: Existing collection, task-success, non-target drift and action-replay checks pass
Official LeRobot readback matches all selected raw frames, both RGB views, states, actions, language and timestamps
Existing action-chunk boundary, train-statistics and split-isolation checks pass
Raw sources, dataset files, reports and review media remain bound by SHA256
Decode all review-video frames; retain failed audits and their explanations
automatic_checks.threshold_changes: None; this policy changes review workload only

agent_visual_review.keyframes: Every episode, both views: first action, grasp completion and final action

full_trajectory_sample.rounding: Ceiling; cap at the batch size
full_trajectory_sample.selection: Write sample IDs and reasons before visual inspection; cover train and validation where present, include opening and closing, and add relevant anomalous cases
full_trajectory_sample.method: Inspect every observation of each sampled trajectory in chronological dual-view filmstrips, including its initial and final observations
full_trajectory_sample.extra_detail: Use native-resolution views around suspicious contact or motion before clearing a flag

agent_visual_review.exceptions: Inspect reported anomalies and retain their source evidence; a passed success flag alone cannot clear an anomaly
agent_visual_review.record: Reviewer type, exact episode IDs, frame indices, evidence hashes, findings, unresolved items and admission decision

admission.requires: Automatic checks pass, required agent inspection is recorded, and no unresolved blocking anomaly remains
admission.label: accepted_under_assisted_review_v2
admission.escalate_to_maintainer: Ambiguous contact or motion, unexplained significant reset differences, task/instruction mismatch, or an anomaly the agent cannot resolve
admission.release_rule: Admission permits inclusion in a later explicit release; never silently replace an active dataset, split, statistics file or server transfer

limitations: Visual review can miss subtle contact or simulator defects
Thumbnail filmstrip inspection is distinct from real-time video playback and human complete-video acceptance
Data admission establishes neither model task success nor generalization
